# Admin identity: Groups — full-fidelity table and 11-section detail

- **Kind**: feature
- **Date**: 2026-08-05
- **Requested by**: Ian
- **Parent**: #1282 "Admin identity — Users, Groups and Members (epic)"
- **Apply rules**: nativemojo-board-conventions

## Description

Complete global group administration: search and operate on groups, inspect the full group detail inventory, administer hierarchy, identity/auth policy, keys, webhooks, events, audit and metadata.

## Context

Wave 4 restored an 11-section GroupView and #1284 added credentials. Compare current behavior to source and focus on missing behavior, particularly real batch operations and auth configuration.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Group table and 11-section detail preserve useful source flows and the Admin no-group boundary.
- [ ] Activate/deactivate/move/delete batch intentions have real handlers only where verified; unsupported actions are absent or explicitly disabled with rationale.
- [ ] Auth configuration, hierarchy, API keys, webhooks, events, audit and metadata use correct endpoints, graphs and permission clauses.
- [ ] Existing Wave 4/#1284 work is reused and premise-checked rather than duplicated.
- [ ] Mock parity, focused tests/docs, both themes, interactive browser checks and clean console/typecheck are complete.

## Investigation

- **What exists**: `apps/portal/src/pages/GroupDetail.tsx`, Group AdminSection/credential bundles, ModelTable batches and global Admin navigation.
- **What changes**: close remaining group table/detail/action gaps and harden contracts.
- **Constraints**: an inspected group is route data, never active portal group context.
- **Port sources**: `web-mojo/src/extensions/admin/account/GroupTablePage.js`, `GroupView.js`, `GroupAuthConfigSection.js`, `GroupGeofenceSection.js`.
- **Out of scope**: full Member domain; geofence rule editor/simulator (#1287).

## Plan

### Objective

Finish #1410 as a residual hardening pass over the already-shipped Groups surface: restore the useful legacy table inventory, add verified batch activation/deactivation, make every section and mutation obey global/no-group Admin permissions, harden hierarchy and auth-policy editing, and align the mock with django-mojo. Preserve the 10 rail sections plus Configure Auth dialog and reuse #1284 credential components.

Batch delete and batch move remain absent. Because django-mojo also lacks authoritative self/descendant cycle validation for a single `parent` write, assigning/reparenting through the existing picker becomes read-only here; clearing an existing parent remains available behind global manage permission. A backend integrity contract is required before assignment returns.

### Design decisions

- **Keep the Groups surface app-local for this item.** Moving the whole 11-section detail into `portal-mojo/admin` now would either duplicate membership work or invent an adapter to reach app-local `UserDetail`; #1411 explicitly owns the shared membership package and Group-detail composition. Harden behavior now, consolidate the identity bundle in that sibling’s coherence pass.
- **Global Admin permissions are structural.** Route/menu guards and pinned section clauses prevent active-member grants from affecting Admin, while django-mojo remains authoritative.
- **No batch delete.** The backend explicitly lacks Group deletion support.
- **No parent assignment until backend cycle validation exists.** Client-only ancestry checks have the same TOCTOU/integrity weakness for single and batch moves. This item permits only clear-to-root.
- **Retain “All” as table default.** It is more useful to a global operator than legacy active-only filtering and keeps reactivation discoverable.
- **Reconstruct inactive auth inheritance through authorized Group detail.** Changing the public auth endpoint to reveal inactive-group resolution would broaden a public contract; the Admin already has authorized access to the required parent metadata.

### Edge cases and error handling

- Mixed batch results rely on `ModelTable`’s `Promise.allSettled`; successful rows remain applied, failures are counted, selection clears, and lists invalidate.
- Deactivate cancellation returns `null` from `prepare` and issues no requests.
- An already-inactive deactivate or active reactivate remains server-authoritative; errors surface in the batch summary.
- Parent assignment/reparenting is read-only; clearing to root remains server-authoritative.
- Auth parent-chain reconstruction is all-or-nothing. On any ancestor read failure, show own overrides and degraded status read-only; disable Save and Reset rather than deriving mutations from false inheritance.
- Reset-to-inherited is confirmed and preserves unrelated metadata keys.
- Unauthorized rail sections do not mount, count, or fetch.
- Secret-bearing credential responses remain outside Query and Mutation caches.
- Unknown Group kinds keep the existing label/icon fallback.

### Challenge

- **Amended — “full-fidelity” could trigger a wasteful 11-section rebuild.** Repository inspection shows all 11 sections and #1284 credentials already shipped. The plan is now a residual contract/access/action pass.
- **Amended — batch Move looked implementable as repeated `{parent:id}` saves.** django-mojo has no parent-cycle validation; a multi-row handler can corrupt the tree. It is omitted pending a backend integrity contract, while the existing single-row picker gets ancestry protection.
- **Amended — current Configure Auth is not current-contract complete.** It omits GitHub and shows wrong inherited values for inactive groups because the public resolver deliberately ignores them. Both are now explicit work.
- **Amended — no-group shell alone does not make nested UI fail closed.** Identity/metadata editors and Events/API-key prefetches currently mount below their actual permission tier. The plan now gates controls and queries individually.
- **Rebutted — Group detail should immediately move into `portal-mojo/admin`.** That would collide directly with #1411’s required shared membership extraction and the current `UserDetail` cross-record dependency. Consolidation belongs in the sibling coherence pass, not this isolated residual.

### Batch challenge disposition

- **Amended — shared endpoint policy:** a blanket global mock gate would break GroupProvider/GroupSwitcher. Reads retain backend-faithful member access; Admin mutations use pinned global gates.
- **Amended — no-group fail closed:** every route/menu/section/action clause is `sys.*`; unpinned clauses can still consult active membership outside `AdminGlobalScope`.
- **Amended — background requests:** both credential counts and log timelines are permission-enabled with zero denied fetches.
- **Amended — hierarchy integrity:** absent server cycle validation makes single assignment unsafe too. Assignment/reparenting is withheld; only clear-to-root remains.
- **Amended — inventory:** the implementation has 10 rail sections plus Configure Auth, not 11 rail sections.
- **Amended — degraded inheritance:** partial ancestor reads disable Save/Reset; no mutation is derived from a guessed baseline.
